description: This file defines a specialized vector class for complex float numbers using VSX instructions, including various vector operations, blending, arithmetic, and complex number manipulations.

classes.name: Vectorized<ComplexFlt>
classes.description: A vector class for complex float numbers optimized with VSX instructions, supporting complex arithmetic, blending, and mathematical functions.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads complex float data from memory into a vector, with optional count for partial load.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores vector data into memory, with optional count for partial store.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Performs complex multiplication between two vectorized complex floats.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Performs complex division between two vectorized complex floats.

methods.name: abs_
methods.description: Calculates the magnitude (absolute value) of complex numbers.

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the complex conjugate of the vector.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of complex numbers.

methods.name: angle
methods.description: Calculates the phase angle of complex numbers.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two complex vectors.
